assumptions: Source and destination use the same bucket, so the destination keys are relative to the bucket root (no run-date prefix).
Delivery is a custom delivery step (server-side copy, existence check, delete, tagging), since a plain upload cannot do a move.
Where a file matches two rules (e.g. /data_reuse/ plus /cdar/ with a data format, matching CDAR and OTHERS), it is an error and goes to error/.
Skipped files (no extension, no study folder, folder markers) stay in incoming/ untouched.
Data format priority is adam, then sdtm, then raw, as the document states.
The pipeline name entimice_api_pipeline is used instead of the document's name sas_folder_restructure.
